SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.
   C. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

   A. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

11. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

12. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

15. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

16. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   C. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.
   D. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
